citations.review_text: im sad about what hhappened to the game they banoned it

I have complicated feelings about this game. On one hand it is undeniably a fun game and concept, and I feel like I did genuinely get an experience worth my money. Being able to just get into a car and drive for an hour or two with some music or a video on in the background is surprisingly soothing, and for what it is, I would recommend it.

That's not to say it's flawless, however. The endearing jank can sometimes just become straight up tiresome, and I have closed this game on more than one occasion with a sour taste in my mouth because I was shafted by something completely out of my control. That's not even mentioning the fact that it hasn't had an update in a long, long time, and the only real news we've gotten here is a short post that clarifies pretty much nothing at all from over a year ago.

From what I understand, this game is having engine troubles. From what I can piece together, I think that this game was meant to be something fun that got out of their control in terms of popularity. I can sympathise with that, and I really do feel for them. But, and this is my main gripe, I don't think the devs have handled the situation that well.

In the aforementioned post from June last year, one of the devs (Genesz) notes that they don't like social interactions. That's something I can empathise with too, considering that I myself suffer from very severe social anxiety, but if you have a sizeable community relying on your word for updates (least of all on a product that cost actual money), I just don't think that's a good enough excuse.

I have no idea if the devs will ever read this (or if anyone will at all), but I hope they do. If you are, then know that I am not angry, and I feel like a lot of others aren't either. I'm just frustrated at the complete lack of communication, only made worse by the state the game was left in before the hiatus. Bad news in regards to the development of the game is better than no news at all, because at least bad news shows that the…
It's been a while since an update, no (actual) communication from the dev

He has acted very unprofessional and very combative in the community posts. Honestly he has come off as a bit of a #@%$. I have never conversed with him personally but from just reading his replies to the community asking for basic info on where the state of the game is and him replying in almost a trolling and disrespectful manner and even accusing people of being bots when they bring up valid points, rubbed me the wrong way. I have since uninstalled this decrepit bug pit and hung up my give a @#$%.

The Long Drive is basically a road trip powered by hope, gasoline, and whatever glitches the universe feels like throwing at you. It really is a very long drive — like “did the dev forget to put an ending” long.

Would I recommend it? Absolutely.
Would I trust it with my life? Absolutely not.

It pains me to give this game a negative review even though I spent many hours in it and find it quite unique.

The issue is this game is very much dead and abandoned - in a fairly terrible state too. The game itself is still very glitchy and janky, and honestly, that's part of the charm of playing it so I give it a bit of a pass there.

However, for the developers to have the gall to make a community post saying "No, the game isn't abandoned we just hate social media updates" nearly an entire year ago (as of this review) is egregious and disrespectful. The last update was 9 months before that post, which means the last update (as of this review) was 1 year and 7 months - and that was for the BETA branch, not the main. It's dead.

To make things worse I'm seeing other negative reviews here saying one of the devs is working on another project under a different name (a game called Poly Roam). Or that the dev is trying to rewrite this entire game in the Godot game engine. This is not a good sign. In fact, this is a terrible idea, and I say this as someone who, as a hobby, makes small games in Godot. The future is grim.

Other reviewers here also report that multiplayer is essentially broken and doesn't work. Worth noting as well. I mainly play in single player so I personally wouldn't know, but judging from the videos I see, multiplayer looks terrible and buggy.

After months without updates, the gameplay became stale, to the point where there is no reason to keep it on your disk. Multiplayer is nothing worth writing about. Latency issues make it very hard to play with friends who might not have the best internet connection.

The most egregious thing about the game is the developer himself, who seems to be gaslighting fans into thinking he does still care about this project while never updating on progress, instead choosing to upload gameplay from other games to his YouTube channel. Some people choose to believe a man who quit his job because of the profit this project gave him can't pump out an update for it in over 2 years, while others sensibly doubt the credibility of his reassurances and ask what he was up to all this time.
DO NOT PAY FOR THIS GAME. YOU DON'T WANT TO SUPPORT THIS GRIFTER.

TLDR: Game abandoned and left in a buggy state. Do not buy.

It pains me to give this game a negative review even though I spent many hours in it and find it quite unique.

The issue is this game is very much dead and abandoned - in a fairly terrible state too. The game itself is still very glitchy and janky, and honestly, that's part of the charm of playing it so I give it a bit of a pass there.

However, for the developers to have the gall to make a community post saying "No, the game isn't abandoned we just hate social media updates" nearly an entire year ago (as of this review) is egregious and disrespectful. The last update was 9 months before that post, which means the last update (as of this review) was 1 year and 7 months - and that was for the BETA branch, not the main. It's dead.

To make things worse I'm seeing other negative reviews here saying one of the devs is working on another project under a different name (a game called Poly Roam). Or that the dev is trying to rewrite this entire game in the Godot game engine. This is not a good sign. In fact, this is a terrible idea, and I say this as someone who, as a hobby, makes small games in Godot. The future is grim.

Other reviewers here also report that multiplayer is essentially broken and doesn't work. Worth noting as well. I mainly play in single player so I personally wouldn't know, but judging from the videos I see, multiplayer looks terrible and buggy.

Do not purchase. 
In all honesty, I love this game. However, I would never recommend this game to anyone who ever would expect any kind of update/ "bug-free" experience/ optimized game. 
The game is dead, the developer has completely restarted development on everything and rewriting the code in Godot. He also spent a year trying to rework the terrain just to remove all of it. His updates are scarce and misleading to give hope. His lack of care for the project is okay in my  books, but leading on people is not. He says he DOES NOT like social interactions, but this seems to only apply to negative news of the project being dead, not to any "possible updates." The game is dead and quite frankly, very annoying to play in multiplayer. The modding community is the only thing that really seems to care about the game. The mods DO NOT work in multiplayer, which is very upsetting but makes sense. 

I still love this game and will continue playing it, but it is not one I would recommend past a niche audience that enjoys dead games. Gene, stop arguing with randoms on forums and leading us on. Tell us the game is dead or show you still care.
